digest.component_or_area: metrics harvesting adapter for GitHub Actions
propositions: Coverage percentage and CI-health metrics from GitHub Actions run history must be extracted and persisted to a durable, git-tracked snapshot store to survive the short GHA log-retention window.
The GHA adapter must parse coverage from pytest-cov TOTAL line in run-log tail using word-boundary anchoring and compute red-to-green recovery intervals from paired fail/pass runs.
The snapshot harvester script must write metrics to `.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson` (not `reports/`) and must remain independent of the core metrics command modules to maintain portability.
The CI workflow must not be modified to commit snapshots; the harvester operates post-hoc via GHA API to capture logs and run metadata after test completion.
Core metrics modules (`registry.py`, `__init__.py`) and future `_commands/metrics.py` must not import the isolated GHA adapter to enforce separation of concerns.
